info.title: Semester Developer Console API - proposed contract
info.description: Design artifact, not a deployed service. Covers developer-console control-plane resources, not the entire Education OS or curriculum API. Production activation requires implementation, contract validation, security review and institutional authority. No real server URL is declared.

patch.description: Moves an open finding to resolved (publisher-evidenced fix) or accepted (reviewer risk acceptance).

parameters.name: If-Match
parameters.description: ETag of the finding as last read.

requiredEvidence.description: Evidence the reviewer requested to resolve the finding, as supplied at creation.

reconciliationEvidenceId.description: Set when the pilot is reconciled. Null before reconciliation.

outputLocation.description: Absolute URL of the completed output, such as an export payload. Null until the job completes, and always null for kinds that produce no output.

oauth2.description: Illustrative authorization service locations. Authorization-code clients require PKCE S256. Machine-client profile is defined in the architecture guide.
